svg.title: DIA-203 · The volume knob
svg.desc: An engraved plate of the front of an old valve wireless set, cropped close. On the left a slatted speaker grille gives out sound. Below it is a small volume knob with fresh pencil ticks and an arrow showing it has just been turned down. It stands for content filters, rate limits, thresholds and usage caps. On the right is a large tuning dial whose pointer is held in place by a twisted wire run through its knob and closed with a lead seal. It stands for incentives, goals and competition. The same station plays.
svg.text: PART II · CONSTANTS, BUFFERS, AND INFRASTRUCTURE
It turns. The set gets quieter.
DIA-203 · A parameter changes how loud the system is, not what it plays.
